master.alt: Phone-first edited aerial journey from the Wachau region to the Grabenwand climbing area
master.note: OWNER-APPROVED PHONE PILOT — assembled from owner-approved DJI_0793 full source and DJI_0799 source seconds 21.000 to end. The derivative is 1280x720 H.264/yuv420p, faststart, with a short transition between separate flights. The map-confirmed name is Grabenwand; prior intake wording used Grimmwand/Grünwand. Source masters remain outside the PWA. Desktop and tablet derivatives are intentionally deferred.
